buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods

3. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 4. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 5. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS & CONDITIONS (ATC) (1) Experience Criteria: Past performance experience should be based on Single order of same / similar category required with supply proof such as CRAC / Installation Report / Appreciation Letter, to be submitt ed in Technical Bid, otherwise the offer will be summarily rejected. Proof of after-sale service satisfaction l etter from organizations such as IIT/NIT/Govt. Universities / Institutes etc. should be submitted while biddin g. (2) Turnover: Bidder must submit the Annual Turnover of the Bidder, along with Audited balance sheet & Profit & Loss Statement OF last 3 Financial Year. (3) Technical Compliance: Bidder must provide a comparative technical compliance sheet(s) item wise by mentioning make/model/specifications of the quoted items along with the detailed specifications of the i tem mentioned in the Bid. Requisite catalogues/information/website links of the quoted items MUST be sub mitted in the technical bid. Mere copying and pasting of the published bid technical details on the bidder's l etterhead is not considered as authenticated technical data compliance. Failing of the appropriate technica l compliance sheet(s) is summarily rejecting the bider. (4) Pre-Technical Inspection: Based on the requirement, the bidder may be asked to arrange pre-techni cal inspection during technical evaluation before financial opening of the selected/all items at the Buyers' p lace for technical evaluation. Absence or failure of the same will lead to the bid/bidder(s) is summarily reje cted. (5) Client List: List of the Clients with Contact Details using same / similar Instruments for Items/Product Quality Assurance in Madhya Pradesh. (6) Registered Office or Service Centre: Bidder must have Registered Office or Service center or Franc hise, in Local state(Madhya Pradesh). The bidder must provide the legal proof of Registration Certificate/Ag reement between both Parties for the same. Full contact details of the office must be provided for cross ve rification. (7) Warranty: Minimum 12 months from the date of supply. (8) Quoted rates must be inclusive of all taxes, GST, duties, transportation, and incidental charges. (9) Bidder must arrange a technical expert/engineer as and when required during the warranty period, Wit hin 24 hours of complaint. (10) Manufacturer Authority Letter: Need Tender Specific Authority Letter from the OEM with Warrant

y Confirmation, on OEM Letter Head. (11) ISO Certificate (9001 or Latest) of the Bidder along with bid should be attached. (12) Trainer Bio-Data: Bidder must provide trainer/Engineer detailed biodata indicating the relevant/ te chnical experience along with bid documents. The training period for the equipment should be minimum of 1 to 2 Days. (13) The penalty will be raised for late delivery (LD charges as per Madhya Pradesh Procurement Policy r ules) and commissioning of item/products as mentioned in the bid will be deducted from bills. (14) Any Minor/Major damage which is not covered in warranty till delivery/commissioning and final testin g will be borne by seller. (15) Documents Required: a) Experience documents b) Turnover documents c) Technical Compliance proof d) Client list e) Registered Office or Service Centre proof f) Manufacturer Authority Letter g) ISO Certificate (9001 or Latest) of the Bidder h) Trainer Bio data Details i) Copy of the bidder's PAN card and GST registration certificate. j) Percentage of local content certificate (16) Acceptance of Tender Conditions: Submission of tender implies unconditional acceptance of all th e above terms and conditions. UPLOAD BID RELEVANT DOCUMENTS ONLY .
